importantNotes: Electromagnetic waves are transverse in nature.
Electric and magnetic fields are perpendicular to each other and direction of propagation.
EM waves do not require material medium for propagation.
Electric and magnetic energy densities are equal in EM waves.
commonMistakes: Confusing E and B field relations
Ignoring vector nature of Poynting vector
Mixing up absorbing and reflecting surface radiation pressure
